verses.ar:
عِبَادَ اللّٰهِ رِجَالَ اللّٰهِ ۞ أَغِيثُونَا بِأَهْلِ اللّٰهِ
وَكُونُوا عَوْنَنَا فِي اللّٰهِ ۞ عَسَى نَحْظَى بِفَضْلِ اللّٰهِ
verses.tr:
ʿIbādallāhi rijālallāhi ۞ Aghīthūnā bi-ahlillāh
Wa kūnū ʿawnanā fi-llāhi ۞ ʿAsā naḥẓā bi-faḍlillāh
verses.en: O servants of Allah, O men of Allah, come to our aid through the People of Allah, and be our support in Allah's cause, so we may attain the favour of Allah.

verses.ar:
وَيَا أَقْطَابْ وَيَا أَنْجَابْ ۞ وَيَا سَادَاتْ وَيَا أَحْبَابْ
وَأَنْتُمْ يَا أُولِي الْأَلْبَابْ ۞ تَعَالَوْا وَانْصُرُوا لِلّٰهِ
verses.tr:
Wa yā aqṭāb wa yā anjāb ۞ Wa yā sādāt wa yā aḥbāb
Wa antum yā ulī-l-albāb ۞ Taʿālaw wa-nṣurū lillāh
verses.en: O poles, O noble ones, O masters, O beloved ones, and you, O people of understanding — come and grant us victory for Allah's sake.

verses.ar:
سَأَلْنَاكُمْ سَأَلْنَاكُمْ ۞ وَلِلزُّلْفَى رَجَوْنَاكُمْ
وَفِي أَمْرٍ قَصَدْنَاكُمْ ۞ فَشُدُّوا أَمْرَكُمْ لِلّٰهِ
verses.tr:
Saʾalnākum saʾalnākum ۞ Wa li-z-zulfā rajawnākum
Wa fī amrin qaṣadnākum ۞ Fa-shuddū amrakum lillāh
verses.en: We have asked you, we have asked you; we have hoped for nearness through you, and in this matter we have turned to you — so take up our cause for Allah's sake.

verses.ar:
فَيَا رَبِّي بِسَادَاتِي ۞ تَحَقَّقْ لِي إِشَارَاتِي
عَسَى تَأْتِي بِشَارَاتِي ۞ وَيَصْفُو أَمْرُنَا لِلّٰهِ
verses.tr:
Fa-yā Rabbī bi-sādātī ۞ Taḥaqqaq lī ishārātī
ʿAsā taʾtī bishārātī ۞ Wa yaṣfū amrunā lillāh
verses.en: O my Lord, by these masters let my hopes be realised — may glad tidings come to me, and may our affair be made pure and sincere for Allah.

verses.ar:
بِكَشْفِ الْحُجُبِ عَنْ عَيْنِي ۞ وَرَفْعِ الْبَيْنِ مِنْ بَيْنِي
وَصَرْفِ الْقَلْبِ وَالْعَيْنِ ۞ بِنُورِ الْوَجْهِ يَا اللّٰهُ
verses.tr:
Bi-kashfi-l-ḥujubi ʿan ʿaynī ۞ Wa rafʿi-l-bayni min baynī
Wa ṣarfi-l-qalbi wa-l-ʿayni ۞ Bi-nūri-l-wajhi yā Allāh
verses.en: By lifting the veils from my sight, and removing the distance that stands between us; and by turning the heart and eye toward the light of the Face, O Allah.

verses.ar:
صَلَاةُ اللّٰهِ مَوْلَانَا ۞ عَلَى مَنْ بِالْهُدَى جَانَا
وَمَنْ بِالْحَقِّ أَوْلَانَا ۞ شَفِيعِ الْخَلْقِ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ
verses.tr:
Ṣalātu-llāhi Mawlānā ۞ ʿAlā man bi-l-hudā jānā
Wa man bi-l-ḥaqqi awlānā ۞ Shafīʿi-l-khalqi ʿinda-llāh
verses.en: The blessing of Allah, our Master, be upon him who came to us with guidance, and who entrusted us with the truth — the intercessor of creation before Allah.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, send peace and blessings upon him and his family.
